newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Dock says Cityfront Center raises bid.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Dock says Cityfront Center raises bid.

text.p: Chicago Dock & Canal Trust said Tuesday that Cityfront Center LLC has raised its buyout bid for the real estate investment trust to $23 a share from its previous offer of $22 a share.
Chicago Dock agreed in September to be acquired by Newsweb Corp and its CDCT Acquisition Trust unit for $21 a share.

Chicago Dock said it will evaluate the Cityfront Center proposal including the availability of definitive financing for the proposal, and hold discussions with representatives of Cityfront Center regarding the proposal.
Under the merger agreement with Newsweb, Chicago Dock has the right, in certain circumstances, to approve or recommend a superior proposal or terminate the merger agreement with Newsweb Corp.
Cityfront is an affiliate of developer MCL Chicago Homes Inc.
Chicago Dock shares were up 15/16 at 22-3/8 Tuesday.
